risk_title: Proton/electron radiation creates defects, charge traps, and output decay
tabletop_gate: Irradiate coupon stack with mission-relevant proton/electron spectra; report pre/post I-V, EQE, dark current, and annealing behavior.
subscale_in_space_gate: Expose instrumented coupons in LEO with periodic I-V sweeps and temperature/radiation logs.
mission_ready_gate: Show end-of-life power margin after dose equivalent to mission duration plus design margin.
proof_artifact: Radiation test report; dose model; EOL power budget.
notes: Core space-environment risk; must be tested with thermal/vacuum interactions before mission credit.

risk_title: Thermal cycling causes microcracks, delamination, and interfacial stress
tabletop_gate: Cycle full stack across expected hot/cold bounds in vacuum; inspect adhesion, cracks, series resistance, and encapsulant strain.
subscale_in_space_gate: Fly coupon on a thermally representative plate; log cycles and degradation per orbit.
mission_ready_gate: Demonstrate stable output after mission-equivalent cycles with deployable substrate attached.
proof_artifact: Thermal-vacuum cycling report; microscopy; power retention curve.
notes: Highest-priority package/mechanics risk because LEO cycles repeat every orbit.

risk_title: Vacuum and heat drive volatile loss, stoichiometry shifts, ion migration, or electrode reactions
tabletop_gate: Hold encapsulated and unencapsulated stacks at hot-case vacuum; measure mass loss, gas species, and I-V drift.
subscale_in_space_gate: Compare witness coupons with different encapsulation/barrier recipes in LEO.
mission_ready_gate: Qualify stack with bounded outgassing, no critical interface reaction, and acceptable drift under combined stress.
notes: Do not infer vacuum readiness from ambient stability tests.

risk_title: AM0 ultraviolet exposure accelerates photochemical degradation
tabletop_gate: Run AM0 UV dose testing with continuous maximum-power tracking and spectral response checks.
subscale_in_space_gate: Correlate UV exposure telemetry with I-V degradation on exposed coupons.
mission_ready_gate: Demonstrate UV-stable stack or protective coating across mission dose plus margin.
proof_artifact: AM0 UV exposure report; coating selection memo.
notes: AM0/UV spectrum must be explicit in test reports.

risk_title: Atomic oxygen erodes unprotected surfaces in LEO
tabletop_gate: Atomic-oxygen beam test on complete encapsulated stack, edges, interconnects, and coatings.
subscale_in_space_gate: Fly edge-sealed coupons at a known LEO altitude/inclination; inspect erosion and leakage.
mission_ready_gate: Show AO erosion margin for selected orbit or choose altitude/attitude constraints that avoid the risk.
proof_artifact: AO test report; orbit-dependent erosion model.
notes: Risk depends strongly on chosen LEO altitude and exposed materials.

risk_title: Encapsulation/barrier design trades protection against mass, flexibility, optical loss, and repairability
tabletop_gate: Compare barrier recipes for water/oxygen ingress, UV loss, AO resistance, flex fatigue, and areal density.
subscale_in_space_gate: Fly at least two barrier variants with identical cells to separate cell vs package degradation.
mission_ready_gate: Freeze an encapsulation stack with verified optical transmission, edge seal reliability, and mass budget fit.
proof_artifact: Encapsulation trade matrix; selected stack drawing; areal-density budget.
notes: Bridge from promising cell to usable SNS power surface.

risk_title: Manufacturing variability and scale-up reduce yield, uniformity, and predictability
tabletop_gate: Build statistically meaningful coupon lot; report efficiency distribution, defect density, and process controls.
subscale_in_space_gate: Fly representative lot samples, not only best cells.
mission_ready_gate: Establish acceptance sampling and derating rules for production lots.
notes: Needed before many-node swarm assumptions use PSC averages.

risk_title: Flexible deployment, stowage, vibration, and handling damage films or interconnects
tabletop_gate: Run stow/deploy cycles, bend-radius testing, launch vibration, and post-test I-V/EL imaging.
subscale_in_space_gate: Demonstrate deployment on a small space-rated carrier or hosted payload.
mission_ready_gate: Qualify integrated PV blanket, hinges, interconnects, and strain relief at mission scale.
proof_artifact: Deployment test report; vibration report; post-deploy power map.
notes: ROSA-like deployables are structural reference points, not PSC blanket qualification.

risk_title: Micrometeoroid/orbital debris punctures create localized shorts, cracks, or contamination paths
tabletop_gate: Hypervelocity impact or surrogate puncture test with electrical isolation analysis.
subscale_in_space_gate: Track degradation/local failures on exposed coupons where possible.
mission_ready_gate: Design segmentation and bypass so single damage sites do not cascade.
notes: Large-area thin films increase exposed target area.

risk_title: Measurement optimism: short demonstrations under-report long-duration, combined-stressor degradation
tabletop_gate: Define combined-stressor protocol and minimum reporting fields before accepting evidence.
subscale_in_space_gate: Require public/partner data with time-resolved environment telemetry, not only headline efficiency.
mission_ready_gate: Use model validated by ground + flight data to predict EOL power with uncertainty bands.
proof_artifact: Qualification protocol; data schema; validated degradation model.
notes: Short in-space demonstrations are pathfinders until paired with telemetry and duration scaling.
